title: Undercurrents Surging
next_chapter_hook: That jade slip lay quietly on the stone table, its yellowed surface bearing a line of familiar handwriting that seemed to traverse ten years of time — it was his father Chen Xuan's calligraphy.

text.content:
The air within the Council Hall seemed to freeze.

The Fifth Elder's turbid old eyes suddenly gleamed with sharp light, like two daggers tempered with poison, piercing directly toward Chen Ji. The surrounding servant disciples immediately fell silent, some already quietly retreating, afraid of being caught in this unwarranted disaster.

Yet Chen Ji merely lifted his head slowly, a faint smile even hanging at the corner of his lips.

dialogue.content:
「Chen Ji, have you concealed your true cultivation? Speak truthfully!」

The Fifth Elder's voice echoed through the hall, carrying the unique pressure of a late Foundation Building cultivator. Several timid servant disciples' legs went weak, nearly kneeling to the ground.

text.content:
However, Chen Ji merely leisurely straightened his robes and rose to his feet with composure.

「Fifth Elder is discerning.」His voice was unhurried, as if narrating something unrelated to himself,「This disciple has been in the sect for three years, and my cultivation has stagnated — this is a well-known fact. If you speak of concealing cultivation... may I ask Elder, what reason would this disciple have to hide my abilities?」

His gaze met the Fifth Elder's scrutiny calmly, showing neither fear nor guilt. That composure反而让对方一时语塞。

dialogue.content:
「You...」

The Fifth Elder's expression slightly changed, about to berate again, when a cyan shadow swept in from outside the hall, landing beside Chen Ji.

「Fifth Elder, the second round preparations are imminent. Perhaps it is not appropriate to investigate a disciple's cultivation matters now?」

Su Qingyao's voice was cold as frost, and with one appearance, she cut off the tense atmosphere in the hall.

text.content:
Chen Ji's eyelid barely perceptible twitched.

Su Qingyao. This was the first time the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow had appeared before him, and in such a manner. His gaze lingered on her back for a moment — that cyan figure was like an unsheathed sharp sword, and even just standing there, radiated a presence that could not be ignored.

But what concerned him more was the flash of inquiry in her eyes.

dialogue.content:
「Senior Fellow Su's words are mistaken.」The Fifth Elder narrowed his eyes,「This seat was merely conducting a routine inquiry. Where is the question of investigation?」

Su Qingyao replied coolly:「If the Fifth Elder was merely inquiring, there would naturally be no issue. But your earlier tone seemed to have already deemed Brother Chen a suspect. This恐怕不符合宗门规矩.」

Her gaze swept across those present:「All fellow disciples are watching. Please choose your words carefully, Elder.」

text.content:
The Fifth Elder's expression turned gloomy, yet he could find no rebuttal.

Though Su Qingyao was merely the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, the Su Family behind her had deep roots within the sect. Even an elder like himself had to give them some face. Moreover, every word she spoke was reasonable. If he continued to press the matter, he would appear to be bullying the weak.

「...Very well.」The Fifth Elder snorted coldly, turning with a sweep of his sleeve,「In the second round competition, this seat would like to see how long he can hold on!」

dialogue.content:
After the Fifth Elder departed, Su Qingyao turned to Chen Ji, her gaze sharp as a blade:「Follow me.」

She offered no explanation, nor waited for a reply,径直向殿外走去. Chen Ji沉默了一瞬, 还是跟了上去.

两人一前一后穿过回廊,直到行至一处僻静的竹林小亭, 苏青瑶才停下脚步.

text.content:
「Chen Ji.」

Su Qingyao turned around, her moon-white robes slightly floating in the wind, making her appear like a celestial being from ancient legends. She直视着陈机的眼睛,声音带着一丝难以察觉的波动:

「你不该出现在那场比试中的.」

竹叶沙沙作响,两人的影子在地上交叠.

Chen Ji remained unruffled, merely tilting his head slightly:「Senior Sister speaks as if?」

「You have been concealing your true abilities.」Su Qingyao's voice was certain,「And concealing them deeply. In that match against Zhou Yuan, your footwork, your reaction speed — certainly not the level a Qi Refining Third Stage cultivator should possess.」

She stepped forward, her gaze pressing close:「Who exactly are you?」

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao pressing relentlessly, Chen Ji faces a critical choice — how to respond to the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's questioning?

choices.text: Retreat to advance, show weakness to gain sympathy
choices.description: Continue playing the废物人设, claiming it was just luck, begging Senior Sister Su not to investigate further.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen through by her
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao is extremely intelligent, there is risk of lies being exposed

text.content:
Chen Ji lowered his eyes, revealing a bitter smile:「Senior Sister jests. If this disciple possessed such abilities, why would I have stayed on the Servant Peak for three years?」

He raised his head, his gaze carrying just the right amount of helplessness:「That day was merely Brother Zhou underestimating me, this disciple got lucky.」

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao stared at him for a long while, then suddenly laughed lightly:「You are skilled at acting. But you forgot one thing —」

She drew a jade slip from her sleeve, lightly tossing it to Chen Ji:「This was picked up near your residence. It carries a very strange spiritual energy fluctuation.」

「So, Chen Ji...」She turned to leave, leaving only one sentence:「I won't ask, but I will always be watching you.」

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶对陈机产生了强烈的好奇心

choices.text: Be partially honest, establish initial trust
choices.description: Admit you do have reservations, but not reveal specific abilities, reaching some tacit understanding with Su Qingyao.
choices.risk_hint: May make her even more curious

text.content:
Chen Ji沉默了片刻,忽然轻声道:「师姐既然问了,我也不好完全欺瞒.」

He raised his hand, fingertips凝聚出一缕淡淡的灵光——那是炼气七层的灵力波动,转瞬即逝.

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply.

「Qi Refining Seventh Stage... you actually...」

Chen Ji withdrew his hand, his expression calm:「还请师姐替我保密.并非有意欺瞒,只是...有些事,不到时候.」

他微微拱手:「第二轮比试在即,师弟还要回去备战.师姐的玉简,师弟改日定当奉还.」

choices.memory_label: 陈机展示了部分实力，赢得苏青瑶初步信任

choices.text: Turn the tables, throw out bait to probe her
choices.description: Don't answer directly, instead reveal some information about conspiracies within the Tianqing Sect, testing Su Qingyao's stance.

text.content:
Chen Ji did not answer. Instead, he stepped forward, lowering his voice:「Senior Sister, do you know why the Fifth Elder publicly targeted a servant disciple like me?」

Su Qingyao's brow slightly furrowed:「What are you trying to say?」

dialogue.content:
「Because someone doesn't want me to win.」Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet each word clear,「The Outer Court gambling den has already opened odds. My odds are one to thirty.」

Su Qingyao's expression slightly changed:「You mean...」

「Senior Sister may investigate who stands behind the bookmaker of these odds.」Chen Ji clasped his hands in farewell,「This disciple takes his leave.」

choices.memory_label: 陈机抛出诱饵，引起苏青瑶对宗门内部阴谋的警觉

text.content:
When he returned to his residence, night had already covered the Servant Peak.

As Chen Ji pushed open the door, he detected a lingering wisp of faint fragrance in the air — that was the distinctive「Corpse Bone Orchid」scent of the Demonic Path. His lips slightly curved upward as he drew out a black jade slip from his chest, his spiritual sense probing within.

After a moment, a cold glint flashed through his eyes.

From the jade slip, Ye Qing's voice came幽幽传来:

「Chen Gongzi, someone is investigating your family background. They've sent Blood Luo Hall agents, who have already arrived at Qingshi Town near the Tianqing Sect.」

「There's another matter — the bookmaker for the Outer Court gambling den has connections to the Xuanwu Sect.」

The last sentence carried a playful tone:「It seems your opponent in the second round is no ordinary person.」

Chen Ji fiddled with the jade slip in his hand, his mind rapidly processing.

Blood Luo Hall — that was the intelligence and assassination agency under the Holy Sect. They were investigating the Chen family... Could it be for Chen Nian?

He took a deep breath, tucking the jade slip into his sleeve.

「看来,有些人已经坐不住了.」

choice.prompt: Facing both the overt pressure of the competition and the covert intelligence vortex, Chen Ji needs to make a strategic choice.

choices.text: Strike first, thoroughly investigate the gambling scheme's mastermind
choices.description: Utilize the Tianji Record's foresight ability to preemptively probe the conspiracy behind the gambling scheme, taking the initiative to attack.
choices.visible_reward: Gain key intelligence, possibly catch enemies' leverage
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption will accelerate heavenly retribution

text.content:
Late at night, Chen Ji sat cross-legged on his bed, fingers gently stroking the Tianji Record Fragment. Faint golden patterns glowed softly in the darkness, emanating an ancient and vast aura.

He closed his eyes, reciting the heart method, sinking his consciousness into that chaotic space.

The scene rippled like water:

He saw the Fifth Elder in secret discussion with a black-cloaked figure. The令牌 worn by that black-cloaked figure bore the unmistakable mark of the Xuanwu Sect!

「Zhou Yuan was merely a pawn... The real killing move comes in the second round...」

Chen Ji猛然睁眼,冷汗涔涔.

choices.memory_label: 陈机消耗天命值，预见玄武宗与五长老勾结的阴谋

choices.text: Hold position, wait for enemies to reveal weaknesses
choices.description: Continue maintaining the废物人设, letting enemies lower their guard, waiting for the optimal counterattack timing.
choices.risk_hint: Opponents may strike to kill in the competition

text.content:
Chen Ji did not utilize the Tianji Record.

He lay on his bed, gazing at the ceiling, a cold smile curling at his lips. Since they wanted to play, then he would play along.

The second round competition... He wanted to see what kind of character the Xuanwu Sect could send.

dialogue.content:
From the fragment, Mo Xiansheng's voice幽幽响起:「小子,你倒是沉得住气.」

「不过——」那声音带着一丝玩味,「有些事,不是你想躲就能躲的.那位苏丫头留下的东西,你可看了?」

Chen Ji眼神微变,猛然坐起身.

choices.memory_label: 陈机选择隐忍，但墨先生提醒他注意苏青瑶留下的玉简

choices.text: Contact Ye Qing, jointly plan counterattack
choices.description: Form a strategic alliance with Demon Path Saintess Ye Qing, utilizing her intelligence network and connections.
choices.visible_reward: Gain covert support from the Demonic Path faction
choices.risk_hint: May get involved in a larger vortex

text.content:
Chen Ji took out another communication jade talisman, speaking quietly into it. After a moment, Ye Qing's reply came:

「有意思,陈公子终于肯找本圣女帮忙了?」

那声音带着慵懒的笑意:「说吧,你想让我做什么?」

dialogue.content:
「Blood Luo Hall agents, monitor them for me.」Chen Ji's voice was calm,「As for the gambling scheme, I want to know every cent flows into whose pockets.」

Ye Qing laughed lightly:「This will come at a price.」

「After the second round competition, I will give you what you want.」

「Deal.」

choices.memory_label: 陈机与夜清达成合作，共同对抗暗中势力

text.content:
Outside the window, a soft footstep suddenly sounded.

Chen Ji's expression tensed, his form flickering like a specter to the window's edge — yet he only caught a glimpse of a cyan shadow sweeping across the eaves, disappearing into the night in an instant.

His gaze fell upon the windowsill — something new lay there.

A jade slip静静地躺在月光下,泛黄的玉面上隐约可见几道纹路.

Chen Ji皱眉拾起,灵识试探性地探入——下一刻,他的瞳孔骤然收缩.

玉简中封印着一段文字,笔迹苍劲有力,却带着几分熟悉的潇洒.那是...

dialogue.content:
「机儿,若你能看到这段话,说明一切都在按计划进行.」

Chen Ji's hand trembled slightly.

This was his father's handwriting — the handwriting of his father Chen Xuan, who had vanished ten years ago!

「天机录的秘密,远比你想象的更深.找到锁钥,唤醒沉睡的记忆...」

text.content:
The text in the jade slip abruptly ended here, as if deliberately cut off.

Chen Ji tightly clutched the jade slip, his knuckles white. Father's handwriting, missing sister, incomplete Tianji Record... all clues intertwined in his mind into an enormous net.

And he stood at the center of the net.

「锁钥...陈念...」他喃喃道,眼底闪过一抹从未有过的波动.

choice.prompt: Father's dying words brought tremendous impact, Chen Ji faces a new choice —

choices.description: Why would Su Qingyao have Father's keepsake? How much does she know? Must confront her directly.

text.content:
Chen Ji's身形一闪,破窗而出.

In the moonlight, the cyan figure had not yet gone far. He urged his lightness skill, moving like a stream of light to pursue.

「苏师姐,请留步!」

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao stopped her脚步,转过身来.月光照在她清冷的面容上,眸中带着几分意外.

「你追来了?」她轻声道,「看来,你已经看过玉简了.」

「这是父亲的遗物.」陈机的声音压得很低,却带着不容忽视的颤抖,「你从哪里得到的?」

choices.memory_label: 陈机发现苏青瑶与父亲陈玄之间存在某种联系

choices.text: Endure in silence, secretly investigate Su Qingyao's background
choices.description: Don't alert the enemy, investigate Su Qingyao's connection to the Chen family through Ye Qing's intelligence network.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may discover the clues first

text.content:
Chen Ji withdrew his raised foot.

他站在月光下,目送那道青色身影消失在夜色中,手指却将玉简攥得更紧.

「苏青瑶...」他低声念着这个名字,眼中的情绪复杂难辨.

dialogue.content:
「哦?没追上去?」墨先生的声音带着几分意外,「小子,你比我想象的更能忍.」

「有些事,不急于一时.」陈机的声音恢复了平静,「夜清,帮我查一个人——苏青瑶.她与陈家,有何关联.」

choices.memory_label: 陈机选择隐忍，通过夜清调查苏青瑶背景

choices.text: First handle the competition, temporarily set aside father's affairs
choices.description: The priority is tomorrow's competition. Family matters can wait — must not sacrifice the important for the trivial.
choices.visible_reward: Focus on preparations, ensure competition success

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, tucking the jade slip into his chest.

Father, Chen Nian, Tianji Record... these clues were important, but now was not the time to pursue them.

「先过了第二轮再说.」他喃喃道,眼中的情绪逐渐收敛,取而代之的是惯常的平静与冷漠.

He turned back into the room, sat cross-legged, and began regulating his breath.

Tomorrow, there would surely be a fierce battle on the competition grounds. Xuanwu Sect's conspiracy, Ye Qing's intelligence, father's dying words... everything would be settled after that.

Moonlight filtered through the window lattice, stretching his shadow long and long.

choices.memory_label: 陈机决定暂时搁置父亲遗言之谜，专注备战第二轮比试

text.content:
Meanwhile, at the Tianqing Sect Outer Court gambling den.

Inside the brightly lit hall, voices clamored. All manner of chips flew across gambling tables, with cheers for betting on Chen Ji's loss rising wave upon wave.

「One to thirty odds! That废物 Chen Ji, and yet someone still bet on him winning?」

A richly dressed young man coldly laughed, slamming a bag of spirit stones onto the「Chen Ji Loses」betting area:「I bet one thousand spirit stones — he won't survive three moves in the second round!」

In a corner, a cloaked figure silently observed all of this.

「有意思...」那人低声自语,声音被压得极低,「看来,很多人巴不得他死啊.」

She gently swayed the wine glass in her hand, the liquid inside glowing with an eerie dark red hue — that was the Demonic Path's distinctive「Blood Dew Wine.」

「陈公子,你可欠本圣女一个大人情了.」

Under the cloaked hat, Ye Qing's lips curved into a meaningful arc.

Deep night, a secret chamber somewhere in Tianqing Sect.

The Fifth Elder knelt on the ground before a figure in black robes. That person's aura was hazy and difficult to discern, and merely sitting there gave off an immense sense of oppression.

「Han Lie has already agreed to act.」The black-robed figure's voice was hoarse and low,「Chen Ji... will not survive the second round.」

The Fifth Elder's forehead was beaded with cold sweat as he连连称是.

Yet at this moment, Chen Ji was still unaware that a lethal trap had quietly taken shape against him.
